title: The Gym Kept Charging Me. The Mail Kept Receipts.
script: My gym kept charging me after I canceled in person. The manager said cancellations only counted through their online form, which conveniently crashed after the final button. I tried three browsers, recorded the error, and sent the cancellation by certified mail. They signed for it, then charged me again. Fine. I disputed the payment and attached the video, the tracking receipt, and their employee's signature. The gym fought back with a screenshot showing my membership was still active. That was useful, because it also showed someone reopened it two days after receiving my letter. The bank reversed three months of charges and blocked future payments. Corporate called to apologize and offered me a free year. I asked whether canceling that year required the same broken form. They mailed a refund instead. Apparently certified mail has a stronger core than their website.
